description: This file defines configuration types and constants for Kubernetes kubectl preferences, including command defaults, aliases, and credential plugin policies.

classes.name: Preference
classes.description: Stores elements of KubeRC configuration including defaults, aliases, and credential plugin policies.

classes.name: AllowlistEntry
classes.description: Represents an entry in the credential plugin allowlist with command matching criteria.

classes.name: AliasOverride
classes.description: Defines command alias configurations including name, command, arguments, and options.

classes.name: CommandDefaults
classes.description: Stores default values for command options.

classes.name: CommandOptionDefault
classes.description: Stores the name and default value of a command option.
